svg.title: Plan to tree
svg.desc: Three panels from left to right. Tag 1: a plan of three ground actions: pick-from-tester inspection_robot_2 c3 tester1; place-in-slot inspection_robot_2 c3 agv1 s3; move-agv agv1 inspection shipping. An arrow leads to tag 2: a registry listing the action names pick-from-tester, place-in-slot, move-agv and three dots for more. An arrow leads to tag 3: a tree whose root is a box labeled Sequence (memory), with three children labeled step 1, step 2 and step 3. Under each step are four small squares: blue, red, blue and green.
